opinions.text:
*950C. A. 9th Cir. Application for injunction pending appeal, presented to Mr. Justice Douglas, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas and Mr. Justice Harlan took no part in the consideration or decision of this application and petition.
